dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Rest? Whyever would we talk about rest?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Being here feels just like walking into my own home gym.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Though of course, you should take a break if you need one.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: There are challenges here that should be taken quite seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: After all, aside from myself, all the other Hexenzirkel mages are not only powerful, but highly capricious. Even if I can pass my own tests with ease, those of the others still require my undivided attention.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You know what they're like by now...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You can certainly consider it a parable. I trust you've pretty much figured out its real meaning?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: *sigh* We can go over it once we've completed this challenge. For now, I need to prepare for the performance... Nothing short of total concentration will do.
